MINIMAX H3 RAVEN MASTER PRODUCTION STUDIO — OPERATIONAL GUIDE

1. 🎬 HOW TIMELINE DIRECTOR INGESTS (Prompt Box vs JSON vs Screenplay Files):
   • Interactive Prompt Box: Type or paste multi-shot scripts directly with [Shot 1], [Shot 2], etc.
   • JSON Ingestion: Paste comfyui_chain_plan.json or connect plan_json_input — it auto-detects JSON and parses shots instantly.
   • File Path Ingestion: Type a local screenplay path (e.g. 'screenplays/halo_2005/') and it auto-loads scenes!
   • Shot Mode Dropdown: Choose 'Continuous_Sequence (All Shots Combined)' for seamless streaming, or pick 'Shot 1', 'Shot 2' to test individual beats.

2. 🧠 ATTENTION ENGINE (Comfy-Kitchen / SDPA vs SageAttention):
   • SageAttention 2.2 is 100% OPTIONAL: If SageAttention is not installed, RAVEN automatically falls back to ComfyUI's native PyTorch SDPA / Comfy-Kitchen backend without errors.
   • Nobody needs to deal with tricky C++ compiler hassles if they prefer native ComfyUI attention.

3. ⚡ LoRA RULES & WHY NO TURBO LoRA:
   • RAVEN already has its own dedicated 4-step consistency turbo LoRA baked directly into the model loader at strength 1.0!
   • NEVER stack an 8-step Turbo LoRA on top: two different turbo schedulers will clash and distort timesteps.
   • Content LoRAs work great: 35mm Cinema (CinematicMH3-V01), Red Dragon Camera, Combat LoRA, Realism LoRA.
   • Genre / Stylistic LoRAs can be dynamically toggled via the LoRA stack according to scene needs.

4. 📡 LIVE CONTINUOUS STREAMING & RTSP / RTMP:
   • WebSocket fMP4: Streams live frames directly to your ComfyUI browser canvas as it generates.
   • Local RTSP Server: Set broadcaster to 'RTSP_Stream_Local' and watch live in VLC (Media > Open Network Stream > rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/live) or OBS Studio.
   • RTMP Streaming: Set to 'RTMP_Stream_YouTube' or 'Twitch', enter your stream key, and broadcast 24/7 without frame drops.

subject_definitions: <MASTER CHIEF> is the towering 7-foot super-soldier in weathered olive-green MJOLNIR Mark V Powered Assault Armor with reflective gold visor, scarred titanium plating, speaking in a calm deep resonant bass with unshakeable stoic discipline and lethal tactical awareness and <SPARTAN> is the cybernetically augmented super-soldier in heavy MJOLNIR powered armor with gold faceplate visor, speaking in a clipped precise military cadence. and <CAPTAIN KEYES> is the seasoned 50-year-old UNSC naval commander in crisp charcoal officer uniform with gold trim, pipe clenched in teeth, weathered authoritative features, speaking in a deep commanding naval baritone with grave resolute composure and <CORTANA> is the holographic luminous blue female AI entity with sleek digital circuitry flowing across her translucent form, speaking in an articulate calm resonant female tone with playful intelligence and underlying emotional vulnerability. and <MAJOR SILVA> is the intense hardened ODST Major in black tactical shock trooper armor with scarred jaw, speaking in a sharp aggressive military bark.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, detailed_description: In INT. CINEMATIC SCENE - CONTINUOUS, [0.00s-4.60s] Camera establishes int. cinematic scene - continuous: HALO Alex Garland 2/6/05 2 . A series of scorched snapshots. Fragments. As memory. This is MASTER CHIEF'S DREAM. OPEN ON a SPARTAN HELMET, and a REFLECTION in its visor. In the reflection, we see buildings. The design and architecture of the buildings tell us this is the distant future. And twin suns tell us this is not Earth. The suns are low in the sky, and bathing the landscape blood red. SNAP BACK to show the full figure of the SPARTAN. Seven foot tall, clad head-to-toe in MJOLNIR armor, holding an MA5B ASSAULT RIFLE -MASTER CHIEF. SNAP BACK AGAIN to reveal, behind MASTER CHIEF, another fifty SPARTAN WARRIORS. All the SPARTANS have their gaze directed at the skies ... where a vast shadow or cloud is eclipsing the twin suns. A shadow which resolves itself into literally thousands of COVENANT DROP-SHIPS. CUT TO A BATTLEFIELD. The buildings are now destroyed. Skeletal steel frames push from rubble, providing only a suggestion of the structures that once stood. Intimate architectural interior of INT. CINEMATIC SCENE - CONTINUOUS: realistic set dressing, prop arrangement, and physical materials. In the background, ambient interior environmental elements remain active and alive. [4.60s-9.78s] Across this wasteland, the SPARTANS and the COVENANT are locked in ferocious combat. The SPARTANS are super-warriors. Combat machines -except that beneath their armor is genetically-refined human flesh and blood. Despite their physical size, they are fast. As we watch them TURN-AIM-FIRE, the speed of their reactions is unnatural. They seem fuelled by nitrous oxide and amphetamines. And there is something HYPNOTIC about the way they fight. Amidst the chaos, there are patterns. Across the battlefield, we can see PRECISE MOVEMENTS echoed from SPARTAN to SPARTAN. The same motion in the way a weapon is raised, the leap and roll to avoid an explosion. The impression is of method within the madness of no-holds barred combat. The SPARTAN warrior training is embedded deep within them. Almost coded. The COVENANT provide a contrast. Among the various species that make up the alien ranks, we can see the tall and regal ELITES, the massive HUNTERS, the gorilla-sized GRUNTS, the thin and feral JACKALS. And they all fight with their own brand of specialized ULTRAVIOLENCE. Less controlled than their human enemy, they are zealots, rabid. They roar as they charge, plasma blazing from their weaponry. In close quarters, they tear and rip and claw. [9.78s-14.38s] Many more of the alien warriors are falling and dying. But they can afford it. In comparison to the SPARTANS, the COVENANT are far, far greater in number. As we watch the scene unfold, something becomes clear. The tide of the battle is turning inexorably against the humans. CUT TO MASTER CHIEF maintaining a barrage of fire as the SPARTANS to the left and right of him are lacerated by plasma fire. CUT TO A SPARTAN as a plasma grenade sticks to his chest. He doubles up to protect his brothers -then flies apart as the grenade explodes. CUT TO Another SPARTAN walking: dazed, blackened, blood-smeared, half his armor blown from his body, half his arm hanging useless at his side. CUT TO A group of THREE SPARTANS driving a WARTHOG VEHICLE -one driving, one on shotgun, one on the rear canon -as they break ranks to CHARGE the enemy... then skid, roll and die under a rain of fire. Here, and throughout, the combat feels real. Hard, bloody, and brutal. CUT TO The city burning. CUT TO The twin suns blazing. CUT TO A black screen, and sudden silence. Over this, a caption appears: CAPTION Year 2552. A coalition of alien species, the Covenant, are waging a genocidal holy war against mankind. The caption fades, to be replaced by: CAPTION Mankind is losing.
